name: agent-primitives
description: Portable agent patterns — reviewers, gates, and workflows that deploy to Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and any AGENTS.md harness from one source of truth.

plugins.name: verification-gate
plugins.description: Two read-only reviewers that run before an agent may declare a task done: verification-critic (reward-hacking and spec drift) and architecture-reviewer (structural decay). Optional Stop hook refuses to end a turn on red Tier-1 gates.
